question: Nayab Singh Saini was appointed the Chief Minister of _____ in October 2024.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Haryana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nayab Singh Saini** was appointed as the **Chief Minister of Haryana** in **October 2024**.
 
• **Haryana** is a state located in **northern India** and is known for its rich history and significance in Indian culture.
 
• The state was carved out from the former **Punjab state** on **1 November 1966** on a linguistic basis.
 
• Haryana is a major agricultural state and is often referred to as the **"Green Land of India"** due to its contribution to the country's food grain production.
 
• The state is also known for its significant role in the **Indian freedom struggle** and for being the site of the historic **Battle of Panipat.**
 
• **Nayab Singh Saini** is a prominent political leader known for his contributions to the state's development and governance.
 
• Haryana has a robust industrial base, with sectors such as **automobile manufacturing, IT services, and education** contributing to its economy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Himachal Pradesh**__

 __
 
• **Himachal Pradesh** is a state in northern India known for its **Himalayan landscapes and hill stations.**
 
• Its capital is **Shimla**, which is a popular tourist destination.
 
• The state is famous for its **apple orchards and trekking routes.**
 
• The region is also known for its contribution to **hydroelectric power generation** in India.
 
 
 
• **Jharkhand**__
 __
 
• **Jharkhand** is a state in eastern India known for its **mineral wealth, especially coal and iron ore.**
 
• The state is rich in natural resources and has a significant tribal population.
 
• It is home to prominent industrial hubs like **Jamshedpur** and **Bokaro Steel City.**
 
 
 
• **Punjab**__
 
 
• **Punjab** is a state in northern India and is often referred to as the **"Granary of India"** due to its high agricultural productivity.
 
• The state is known for its **rich cultural heritage** and is the birthplace of **Sikhism.**
 
• Its capital is **Chandigarh**, which is also a union territory and serves as the capital of Haryana.
